classification: Cumulative performance and correctness validation; no algorithm change
timingScope: Sum of native child wall times; preparation, readback, scoring, and observers outside timed stages. Separate workloads are not pooled.

platform.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti, 80 SMs, sm_86
platform.build: Release; CUDA, OpenMP and IPO enabled; GCC 12.4.0; CUDA 13.2
platform.dependencyScope: Both COLMAP source builds use the same qualified dependencies, including the same optimized Ceres P shared libraries. Pristine denotes COLMAP source, not an entirely pristine dependency stack.
platform.threadScope: 12 requested COLMAP CPU workers, one CUDA worker (GPU index 0). Fusion logs verify use_cache=0 and 12 effective fusion threads in both builds. OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 is the identical ambient setting, not the COLMAP fusion worker count.
platform.clockScope: No global clock or power changes by this experiment. Facade sampled memory clock 9801 MHz in both arms; workload-dependent GPU boost differs. Earlier Fountain used a 9551 MHz memory ceiling, so the two workloads are not pooled.

counterScope.collection: perf stat attached to each native application PID during the timing pass, with normal inheritance; not machine-wide CPU counts.
counterScope.valueUnits: task-clock values are native perf nanoseconds (empty CSV unit on this host); all other event values are counts. CPU seconds and RSS bytes are named separately.
counterScope.coverageLimit: Post-launch attachment; actual kernel attachment acknowledgement, full-lifetime coverage and every-thread coverage were not proved. Counts describe the captured window, not exact lifetime CPU work.
counterScope.interpretation: CPU instructions/cache events are not GPU instructions/cache events. Reduced CPU driver polling can follow shorter GPU execution. Native CPU time and peak RSS are child lifetime wait4 observations.
counterScope.nvml: Whole-device samples every 6 seconds, including other clients; not process VRAM or attributed energy. Short-stage peaks can be missed. No energy-saving claim.

facade.scope: 76-view dense reconstruction from provided cameras; photometric and geometric PatchMatch, then geometric fusion. No SfM, meshing or texturing.
facade.qualityRepeatScope: One additional fusion-only repeat per build, same maps and settings, shared resources; no timing claim from these repeats.

dataset.sourceOriginLimit: Pinned mirror bytes; no independent official archive checksum currently available. Do not claim original-archive byte equality.

facade.datasetSelection: 76 undistorted JPEGs and provided undistorted DSLR calibration; official dslr_scan_eval scan_alignment.mlp and three linked scan PLYs. Mirror files checked against LFS SHA256 or Git blob OIDs. No dataset redistribution.
facade.preparation: Run pristine image_undistorter once on the provided PINHOLE model with max_image_size=1536 and num_threads=12. Freeze the resulting images, sparse model and stereo configuration for both arms. Preserve supplied poses exactly; no one-sided quaternion normalization.

facade.defaults: Original algorithm defaults; auto source count 20 is a maximum (observed 5-20). Radius 5, 15 samples, 5 iterations. Optional lossy storage, rotation-buffer reuse and direct-source uploads off. Existing qualified default-on storage optimizations remain enabled in the fork.

comparison.interpretation: All depth/normal maps byte exact, including unfiltered negative photometric hypotheses also produced by pristine. Parallel fusion clouds are not byte exact. Scores vary slightly on fusion-only repeats; N=2 quality samples do not establish statistical equivalence, nor does N=1 timing establish a confidence interval.

buildCompatibilityChangesOnly: Drop Boost.System from required compiled components because Boost 1.90 provides it header-only
Drop a stale appended -std=c++11 flag so the existing CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17 takes effect
evaluator.settings: Default 0.01 m voxel and laser-beam settings; official beam-aware accuracy and voxel completeness. Native provided world frame; no ICP, scale fitting, or alignment to improve scores.

facade.executionReadbackCorrection: Initial native pristine PatchMatch completed successfully; the reader then rejected finite negative unfiltered photometric hypotheses and would have required exactly 20 sources. Corrected reader accepts finite raw hypotheses and the actual up-to-20 source count. Reused completed pristine native outputs/timing; no hidden pristine rerun.

fountainP11.scope: Earlier seven-stage full pipeline, all 11 original 3072x2048 photos; SIFT, exhaustive matching, fresh SfM/BA, undistortion, photometric and geometric PatchMatch, fusion, Poisson meshing.
fountainP11.settings: Known shared PINHOLE intrinsics from dataset;1500 max feature/undistort/PatchMatch/fusion size;12 CPUworkers;GPU0;Mapper/TwoViewGeometry seed0;remaining algorithm defaults;optional compression/rotation/direct upload flags at defaults. Fresh databases and models each run; no source poses imported.
fountainP11.renderMethod: All 11 camera views of four final meshes (44 renders), max side 768; nvdiffrast CUDA z-buffer, full triangles, perspective-correct encoded vertex RGB, no lighting or UV textures. One camera-centre Sim3 per mesh into the first pristine model frame. RGB PSNR on intersecting foreground; Gaussian 11x11 SSIM on foreground eroded by 5 pixels.
limitations: This earlier workload tested 09a38a91, not afea7fac; do not relabel it as a fresh afea7fac end-to-end run.

Feature/matching database rows and blobs match, but fresh poses, decoded undistorted images, fused clouds, holes and final meshes vary within and across builds. Pristine repeats differ in 0.2% of decoded undistorted pixels.
Final meshes have 68-112 degenerate faces among approximately 2.20-2.32 million faces; no clean-topology claim.

Cross-version PSNR/SSIM comparable to within-pristine/current repeats. Silhouette overlap and depth vary; cross-version values are not uniformly inside a two-repeat scalar envelope. Actual holes change in pristine and fork runs. No identical final mesh, statistical equivalence, independent GT accuracy or photo-texture fidelity claim.
Fountain has no independent ground truth in this check. Render agreement is not held-out accuracy, photo fidelity or a texture-quality measure.

selectedBoundaryOracle.settings: Two iterations, selected odd/non-square mixed input grids, synthetic plane depth range 3-5; immutable seed inputs, fresh outputs.
selectedBoundaryOracle.outcome: Raw depth/normal maps and consistency graphs byte exact against independent pristine CLI; same ordered source IDs, finite/nonempty maps, seed inputs unchanged.
selectedBoundaryOracle.limit: Selected synthetic branch coverage on sm_86, not exhaustive API coverage or performance evidence. An unpublished prototype also passed privately but contributes no published performance claim.

limits: Cumulative build comparison, not the isolated gain of one commit or only the newest GPU series.
One GPU architecture and two scenes; no cross-architecture performance or universal reconstruction-quality claim.
No algorithm or default changes in this validation commit. No new full CTest/pytest claim for this data-only publication.
No formal statistical noninferiority claim; report the separate observation counts and raw scores.
aiDisclosure: AI-assisted investigation and reporting; measurements were run against the exact listed source pins and figures checked against saved native receipts.
